svg.title: Footnote: Source Sans 3
svg.desc: A lowercase a with a raised asterisk, both outlined from Source Sans 3 Bold (SIL Open Font License, which allows outlines in a logo): a word with a note on it, the plainest sign that something is cited. The wordmark is Source Sans 3 Semibold, outlined. Source Sans is a humanist sans, warmer and narrower than Inter, made for reading. Weak in being plain at 16 pixels, where it reads as any sans-serif a.
